uwp_capture_status: ok: UWP app built (Release) and launched via uwp-app-runner (pid 13992, windowTitle 'Background Sensors C# Sample'); captured. The UWP CoreWindow presented only the extended splash to UI Automation, so its content controls were not exposed and Enable/Disable actuation did not register. This scenario is hardware-gated (no accelerometer on this machine), so the buttons produce no output in either app regardless.

features.name: Scenario list: 'Accelerometer DeviceUse'
features.description: The single sample scenario is reachable from the navigation list with its verbatim title.
expected_behaviour: A navigation entry labeled '1) Accelerometer DeviceUse' is present and selected
Selecting it shows the DeviceUse scenario page

features.name: Description text
features.description: Explains the DeviceUse trigger background task listening for accelerometer data.
expected_behaviour: Description reads 'Launches a DeviceUse trigger background task to listen for accelerometer data. Displays the number of data samples received by the background task.'

features.name: Enable button
expected_behaviour: With no accelerometer present it is inert/disabled and status reports 'No accelerometer found' (hardware-gated, matches UWP)

features.name: Disable button
expected_behaviour: Inert/disabled when no task is active (hardware-gated, matches UWP)

features.name: Sample count output
features.description: Displays the number of accelerometer samples received (ScenarioOutput_SampleCount).
expected_behaviour: A 'Sample count:' label with a value ('No data' when no task has run)

features.name: Status block
expected_behaviour: A Status area shows messages; with no accelerometer it shows 'No accelerometer found'

features.name: Defensive hardware-gated fallback
features.description: Visible fallback message when the required accelerometer is missing, so the page never renders blank.
expected_behaviour: Shows 'This sample requires an accelerometer that is not available on this machine.'
